iconStyle: monoline, stroke-width 1.6, rounded caps, no fill — hand-drawn feel, not glossy/gradient

logo.usage: app icon, splash screen, nav bar mark, receipt/order confirmation header

coreFeatures: Signature drink spotlight — Jumping Beans Signature Salted Caramel Oat Flat White, featured prominently, not buried in a full menu list
Coffee menu as the primary/default view — espresso, americano, flat white, cappuccino, latte, mocha, baby chino
Jumping Beans Specials — flavoured oat lattes (vanilla, caramel, hazelnut mocha, chai)
Matcha menu — present but secondary, positioned after Specials, not visually competing with coffee
Combo deals — coffee+pastry and matcha+pastry pairings
Loyalty / 'Perk Me Up' — buy a coffee, collect points
Merch — t-shirts, tote bags, mugs, reusable cups; marked 'Coming Soon', not purchasable yet
Find Our Truck — real vehicle photos + short video, current/upcoming locations
notes: All drinks are made with premium oat milk (plant-based positioning) — reflect this near the top of any menu screen
Avoid honey or other non-vegan ingredients in copy or recipes
Keep visual style flat/solid-color, not glossy gradients, to match the deliberately hand-crafted (non-AI-looking) brand direction
